items.titleZh: 2026墨西哥大奖赛发车阵容：维斯塔潘受罚降至第五位
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘和利亚姆·劳森因练习中发生碰撞而受到处罚，维斯塔潘从第四位降至第五位，劳森可能因车队违规而发车位置更低。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026 Mexican Grand Prix starting grid with Verstappen penalty
detailZh: 维斯塔潘和利亚姆·劳森在练习赛中发生碰撞的处罚是2026年墨西哥大奖赛起跑线上的主要处罚。
维斯塔潘由于这一裁决从第四位降至第五位，而劳森最初预计将从第八位降至第九位，但现在看起来他的起跑位置可能还要低得多，因为他的小红牛车队因MGU-K违规被召唤到 stewards那里。
对此可能的处罚是取消资格赛资格，因此劳森很快就会直接降到最后一排。
他将加入瓦尔特里·博塔斯——已经是资格赛最慢的选手，并且因为更换了凯迪拉克的新引擎部件而受到50个位置的起跑线处罚。
* 练习中碰撞导致的单圈网格处罚** 组件更换导致的50圈网格处罚
detailEn: Max Verstappen and Liam Lawson’s punishments for their practice collision are the headline penalties on Formula 1’s 2026 Mexican Grand Prix starting grid.

Verstappen drops from fourth to fifth as a result of that ruling, while Lawson was initially set to fall from eighth to ninth but now looks like to be starting much lower than that as his Racing Bulls team has been called to the stewards over an MGU-K infringement.
The likely penalty for that is disqualification from the qualifying session, so Lawson could soon drop right to the back.
He’d join Valtteri Bottas - already the slowest qualifier, and also taking a 50-place grid penalty for taking fresh engine components in his Cadillac.
* One-place grid penalty for practice collision** 50-place grid penalty for component changes
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘因碰撞处罚从第四位降至第五位
博塔斯因更换发动机部件而获得50位发车位
keyPointsEn: Verstappen drops to fifth due to collision penalty
Bottas receives a 50-place grid penalty for engine component changes

F1赛事在墨西哥城周日进行，刘易斯·汉密尔顿占据杆位，基米·安东内利仅差一个结果就能成为世界冠军
汉密尔顿领跑乔治·拉塞尔和法拉利车队队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔，而安东内利将在梅赛德斯·维斯塔潘因一档位罚退后从第四位发车。
安东内利只需要在第九名或更高位置完成比赛，无论他的对手如何表现，就能确保他获得第一个一级方程式世界冠军。即使他未能获得积分，只要拉塞尔或汉密尔顿不赢得比赛，冠军就是他的。

detailEn: F1 Mexico GP: Sunday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
What time the 2026 Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix starts, plus the full Mexico City schedule, weather forecast and how to watch live
Formula 1 heads into Sunday in Mexico City with Lewis Hamilton on pole and Kimi Antonelli only one result away from becoming world champion.
Hamilton leads George Russell and Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc on the grid, while Antonelli will start fourth after Max Verstappen one-place grid penalty.

Antonelli needs only to finish ninth or higher to clinch his first Formula 1 world championship regardless of what his rivals do. Even if he finishes outside the points, the title will be his unless Russell or Hamilton wins the race.
That puts both of Antonelli’s remaining championship rivals ahead of him on the grid, setting up a decisive 71-lap Mexico Grand Prix.
Here is everything you need to know ahead of Sunday’s F1 Mexico GP.
How can I watch the F1 Mexico GP?

How you can watch Formula 1 depends on where you are. In the United States, Apple TV is the primary broadcast partner for the 2026 season, with all sessions available on the platform following a multi-year deal. F1 TV remains the series’ global subscription streaming service.

For viewers in the United Kingdom, Sky Sports continues as the championship’s exclusive broadcaster, showing every session live throughout the 2026 season. F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.
Motorsport.com will provide live coverage and updates throughout the Mexico GP weekend.

Sunday is expected to be sunny and dry in Mexico City, with temperatures around 26-27C at the start of the Mexico Grand Prix. Rain is not expected and winds should remain light, but strong sunshine could push track temperatures higher.
Combined with Mexico City’s thin air, the warmer conditions will put additional demands on tyre, power unit and brake temperature management.
Friday sessions: Free Practice 1 and Free Practice 2
Saturday sessions: Free Practice 3 and qualifying

The Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez sits more than 2,200 metres above sea level, where the thinner air creates unusual demands on cooling, aerodynamics and power units despite the circuit’s relatively conventional layout. Its long main straight and stadium section are among its defining features.

items.originalTitle: "Up there for pole": Max Verstappen rues Turn 13 traffic in F1 Mexico GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen said his final lap in Mexico City Grand Prix qualifying was good enough to contend for pole, but he encountered slow cars at Turn 13 and could not complete the run.
detailZh: “本可争杆位”：维斯塔潘对墨西哥大奖赛排位赛第13弯的交通状况表示遗憾
维斯塔潘在看似有望争夺墨西哥站杆位后，于慢圈中遇到诺里斯和哈贾尔
维斯塔潘对未能在墨西哥城大奖赛排位赛完成最后一圈表示遗憾，称在第13弯遇到诺里斯之前，他那一圈“本可争杆位”。
这位四届世界冠军在第二计时段结束时比最终夺杆的汉密尔顿快近0.1秒，他在第一计时段做出紫色最快成绩，随后在第二段与汉密尔顿持平。
然而，维斯塔潘的这一圈从那里开始就崩了。他在12号弯接受了前方赛车脏空气的冲击后，又发现自己必须在13号弯从哈贾尔和诺里斯之间穿针引线。诺里斯试图向右靠，但这打乱了维斯塔潘的节奏，随后他在紧凑的Foro Sol左弯锁死了轮胎。
维斯塔潘因此放弃了这一圈。他的第一圈成绩足以排在第四，但由于在第二节练习赛中于同一组体育场路段弯角与劳森发生冲突，他被罚退一个发车位。因此，他在周日的正赛中将排在安东内利之后起步。
“我到达12号弯时，看到前面有一辆车减速，所以那里就已经因为脏空气而损失时间了，”维斯塔潘解释道。
“然后我还看到那辆车（诺里斯）停在右侧，在那个弯你并不想这样，因为我到达13号弯时已经走了一条不太一样的线路，你失去了参照点，因为你总是以刹车点作为参照，而那里有辆车，所以你看不到它。”
当你在排位赛中当然处于极限状态，并且失去所有这些类似的东西时，赛车的角度会有些不同，那会让你锁死。
对我来说，[整个排位赛期间]抓地力只是变得更好了，我在练习赛中的抓地力很糟糕，所以对我来说在排位赛中只是变得更好了。所以没有什么可抱怨的。
我们当时在争夺杆位，我的最后一圈确实有希望拿下杆位，但不幸的是我们没能完成那一圈。
考虑到在墨西哥城正赛中需要穿越车阵的前景，如果他无法在起步时超越前两排的车手，维斯塔潘表示他预计引擎会过热，周日需要一些管理。
他补充说，即使到1号弯的直道很长，他也更愿意拿到杆位，而不是在开场弯受制于其他赛车——或者因被其他车挡住而面临过热风险。
“一切都会很热，我们知道这一点，但可能更多在于发动机在非常热的时候会如何响应，”他解释道。“也许我们当然还没有真正在那里运行过很多，但我想每个人都会处于同样的境地。”
“在这里，由于温度原因，跟车总是非常困难，但首先我认为我们还必须看看赛车里的速度会如何。
“在这里，我总是更愿意从杆位起步。如果你通常有一个好的起步，那就没问题，你可以比赛。我的意思是，他们可能就在你旁边，但并不是说他们能甩开你，所以那就只是一场转身的战斗。但这一切都取决于你的起步。”
detailEn: "Up there for pole": Max Verstappen rues Turn 13 traffic in F1 Mexico GP qualifying
Max Verstappen encountered Lando Norris and Isack Hadjar on slow laps after looking set to contend for pole in Mexico
Max Verstappen rued being unable to log his final run of Mexico City Grand Prix qualifying, stating that his lap was "up there for pole" before encountering Lando Norris in the final sector.

The four-time champion was almost a tenth up on the lap of eventual poleman Lewis Hamilton at the close of the second sector, having found a purple opening sector and then matching Hamilton in the second part of the lap.

However, Verstappen's lap unravelled from there. Having accepted a smack of dirty air from the cars in front at Turn 12, he then found himself having to thread the needle between Isack Hadjar and Norris into Turn 13. Norris tried to pull over to the right-hand side, but this put Verstappen off his step and he subsequently locked up in the tight Foro Sol left-hander.

Verstappen thus aborted his lap. His first effort was good enough for fourth, but he takes a one-place grid penalty for his FP2 clash with Liam Lawson at the same clutch of stadium-section corners. He thus starts behind Kimi Antonelli on Sunday's grid.
"I arrived to Turn 12 and I see a car slow in front of me, so that's already where you then lose time with the dirty air," Verstappen explained.

"And then I see also the car [Norris] parking on the right, which in that corner you don't want, because I arrive to Turn 13 already doing a bit of a different line, you lose your reference, because you always have your references where you brake, and there's a car, so you cannot see it.
"When you are of course on the limit in qualifying and you lose all these kind of things, and the angle of the car is a bit different, that makes you lock-up.
"For me the grip [through qualifying] only got better, my grip was awful in practice, so it only got better for me in qualifying. So there was not much to complain about.
"We were in the fight for pole, my final lap was up there for pole, for sure, but unfortunately we couldn't finish the lap."

With the prospect of racing through the pack in the Mexico City race, should he be unable to gazump the front two rows at the start, Verstappen stated that he expects the engine to be running hot and require some management on Sunday.

He added that, even with the long run to Turn 1, he would prefer to be on pole rather than having to be at the behest of the other cars into the opening corner - or be exposed to the risk of overheating when stuck behind other cars.

"Everything is going to be hot, we know that, but it's probably more about how the engine will respond to when it is running really hot," he explained. "Maybe we haven't really operated there of course a lot, but I guess everyone will be in the same boat.
"It's always very tough to follow here with the temperatures, but first I think we have to also see how the pace is going to be in the car.

"Here, I would always prefer to start from pole. If you have a good start normally, it's okay, you can race. I mean, they might be next to you, but it's not like they're clearing you, so then it's just a battle to turn around. But it all depends on your start."

detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康在哈斯车队被按在替补席后发表声明，否认了肢体冲突的传闻
埃斯特班·奥康发表了首份声明，回应了在F1墨西哥城大奖赛上与哈斯车队闹翻相关的媒体传闻
被哈斯F1车队弃用的车手埃斯特班·奥康否认了法国媒体关于他与车队领队小松礼雄发生肢体冲突的传闻，并就缺席本周末墨西哥大奖赛作出回应。
奥康在墨西哥被按在替补席上，最可能的原因是在自由练习期间与他的比赛工程师发生了公开分歧。这导致周五晚上与车队进行了一次讨论，这位法国车手与车队之间的关系已变得日益紧张。
由于周五事件的结果，其细节仍然稀少，哈斯决定在周末剩余时间里放弃奥康，由储备车手兼丰田WEC车手平川亮从第三次练习赛开始接管他的赛车。
但法国媒体对奥康与小松之间争执的确切性质猜测纷纷，包括两人之间可能发生肢体冲突的传闻，奥康的团队被迫通过他的社交媒体账户否认这些未经证实的谣言。
奥康的账户发布声明称：“在哈斯F1车队最近做出决定确认我将不参加本周末的墨西哥城大奖赛后，我希望正式回应一些围绕此事的媒体报道和猜测。”
“昨晚，观点分歧导致了与相关方的讨论。我承认这确实发生了，但我坚决否认任何报道或指控，称使用了任何形式的肢体暴力来解决任何性质的任何分歧。”
他补充道：“我强烈谴责一切形式的暴力，并坚信分歧应始终以专业精神、尊重和相互理解来处理。我恳请大家在事件处理期间避免猜测。后续进展将在适当时候通报。”
目前尚不清楚奥康是否会在下周末的巴西大奖赛重返赛车，或者他是否会随这支美国所有的车队完成本赛季。
这位30岁的大奖赛分站冠军得主正在为自己的F1未来而战，他因2027年席位被法拉利新秀拉法·卡马拉取代而遭弃用，留在F1的选择正迅速减少。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon issues statement after Haas benching, denies physical altercation rumours
Esteban Ocon has issued his first statement addressing media rumours around his falling out with Haas at Formula 1's Mexico City Grand Prix
Dropped Haas Formula 1 driver Esteban Ocon has denied French media rumours of a physical altercation with team boss Ayao Komatsu as he issued his response to missing this weekend's Mexico Grand Prix.

Ocon was benched in Mexico, most likely connected to a public disagreement with his race engineer during free practice. That led to a discussion with the team on Friday night as the relationship between the Frenchman and his team has become increasingly strained.

As a result of Friday's events, details of which remain sparse, Haas made the decision to drop Ocon for the remainder of the weekend, with reserve driver and Toyota WEC driver Ryo Hirakawa taking over his car from FP3 onwards.

But with speculation rife in French media outlets over the exact nature of Ocon's spat with Komatsu, including rumours of a possible physical altercation between the two, Ocon's camp was forced to deny those unsubstantiated rumours via his social media accounts.

"Following the recent decision from Haas F1 Team confirming that I will not be participating in this weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix, I wish to formally address some media reports and speculation surrounding the situation," Ocon's accounts posted.

"Last night, a difference in viewpoints led to a discussion with the parties involved. Whilst I acknowledge that this took place, I categorically reject any reports or allegations suggesting that any form of physical violence was used to resolve any differences of any nature."

He added: "I strongly condemn violence in all its forms and firmly believe that disagreements should always be handled with professionalism, respect, and mutual understanding. I kindly ask that speculation be avoided while the matter is being addressed. Further updates will be communicated in due course."
At this point it isn't yet clear if Ocon will return to the car at next weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix or if he will finish the season with the US-owned team at all.
The 30-year-old grand prix winner is fighting for his F1 future after being dropped for 2027 for Ferrari rookie Rafa Camara, with options to remain in F1 dwindling rapidly.
